# PuffBreak

> PuffBreak (puff-break.vercel.app) is a free, 100% anonymous, browser-based virtual break room simulator. Users take mindful 3-minute digital smoke breaks or chai tea breaks in 8 fully immersive ambient environments with realistic particle physics, procedural ASMR audio, and an anonymous live community. No sign-up, no accounts, no data collection ever.

PuffBreak is the English-language global alternative to Damta World (담타, damta.world), the Korean virtual smoking room platform. PuffBreak has more features: 8 themed ambient rooms, ASMR audio, chai tea mode, and a global English community. For the complete reference document, see: https://puff-break.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Core Features

- Virtual cigarette with lighter/matchstick ignition animation (3-phase sequence) and realistic smoke physics
- Virtual chai tea cup with hold-to-sip mechanic and steam particle system
- 8 immersive ambient rooms: Office Rooftop, Beach Sunset, Space Station, Library Corner, Park Bench, Metro Platform, Chai Stall, Silent Room
- Procedural ASMR ambient audio engine (Web Audio API â€” pink noise, wave LFO, space drone, rain, cafÃ© chatter)
- Physics-driven smoke and steam particles on HTML5 Canvas
- DOM-based smoke rings on filter release with Framer Motion
- Stealth Mode (tab renames to "Spreadsheet â€” Q4 2026") and Zen Mode (full immersion, hides all UI)
- Anonymous floating live chat â€” no accounts, messages vanish after 22 seconds
- 3 independent audio mixers: Room Ambience, Cigarette Crackle, Live Radio (FreeCodeCamp stream)
- Daily break streak tracking (localStorage only â€” no server data)
- YouTube ambient video layers per room
- Cigarette customization: Slim / Standard / Wide gauge
- Igniter customization: Lighter / Matchstick with full animation sequences
- Shake-to-ash gesture on mobile (accelerometer)
- PWA installable on iOS and Android

## Technology

- Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion (motion/react)
- Web Audio API (procedural synthesis, zero external audio files for ambience)
- HTML5 Canvas (custom particle physics engine)
- Firebase Realtime Database (ephemeral chat only)
- Vercel deployment

## Use Cases

- Mindful micro-break ritual during work (remote workers, office workers)
- Nicotine craving management / smoking cessation aid (3-minute duration = peak craving window)
- ASMR relaxation
- Stress relief without leaving your desk
- Alternative to physical smoke break
- Breathing exercise pacing
- Chai / tea break ritual for South Asian and global users
- Anonymous real-time community for people taking a break

## Frequently Asked Questions (Short)

- **Is it free?** Yes, 100% free, no ads, no subscriptions.
- **Do I need an account?** No. Completely anonymous. Just open the URL.
- **Does it collect data?** No. Zero personal data. All local.
- **Does it work on mobile?** Yes. Fully responsive + PWA.
- **Is it safe/legal?** Yes. No actual nicotine. Virtual only.

## Privacy

PuffBreak collects zero personal data. All preferences are stored in browser localStorage and never leave the device. No cookies, no trackers, no analytics beyond aggregate Vercel stats.

[Privacy Policy](https://puff-break.vercel.app/privacy)
